page_title: NEW 4-0 TOT | Newcastle v Tottenham Hotspur 13/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Brennan Johnson (Tottenham).
90+3' Substitution. Fabian Schar is replaced by Paul Dummett (Newcastle Utd).
90+3' Eddie Howe has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Joe White (Newcastle Utd) replacing Bruno Guimaraes.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Eddie Howe has decided to make a change. Matt Ritchie (Newcastle Utd) replaces Elliot Anderson.
89' That will be all from Harvey Barnes who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd).
87' 4 - 0 Anthony Gordon takes the corner and Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) rises highest near the penalty spot to plant a brilliant header into the right side of the goal. The score is 4:0.
86' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
86' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) latches on to a pass inside the box, but his low effort towards the right post is well blocked. Newcastle force a corner. They send men into the box.
85' Timo Werner (Tottenham) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
84' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
83' Emerson Royal (Tottenham) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The referee points to the corner flag and Tottenham will take a corner.
81' Substitution. James Maddison makes way for Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham).
81' Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) fires a rebound from mid-range onto the left post!
80' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
79' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) tries to find Alexander Isak, but he puts too much power on the pass.
78' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) is substituted due to injury. Eddie Howe gives a chance to Valentino Livramento.
76' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
75' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
72' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
70' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
70' James Maddison (Tottenham) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
65' James Maddison (Tottenham) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
63' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner with a short pass.
63' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out. Newcastle earn a corner.

63' Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Guglielmo Vicario makes a great save to stop his effort. Newcastle force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
61' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes out his opponent with a horrible challenge and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
61' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
58' It will be a substitution. Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) is ready to enter the pitch as Heung-Min Son walks off.
57' Ange Postecoglou has decided to substitute Yves Bissouma and he is replaced by Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham).
57' Rodrigo Bentancur will be replaced by Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham).
57' Anthony Gordon floats over the free kick into a crowded box. Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) does well to win the ball, but sends his header just wide of the right post from close in.
56' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
55' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner which is cleared.
54' Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The referee signals a corner kick to Newcastle.

51' 3 - 0 It's a goal! Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Bruno Guimaraes. The score is now 3:0.
51' Timo Werner (Tottenham) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Martin Dubravka easily deals with the threat.
50' The resulting corner from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
49' Ange Postecoglou is forced to make a change. Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Emerson Royal.
48' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
47' It's like he was asking for a caution. Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) receives a yellow card.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball goes well wide of the right post.
44' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

43' Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball is out of play and Newcastle manage to earn a corner.
42' The game is interrupted now, Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
41' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) prepares to take a corner kick.
40' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) meets a cross inside the box, but Guglielmo Vicario wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
38' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) will take the corner.
37' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area. The ball goes behind for a corner. Newcastle will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

37' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick.
36' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) leaps above the defender and heads the ball goalwards from a corner by Anthony Gordon, but his effort from the penalty spot flies well over the bar.
36' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) steps up to send the ball in.

32' 2 - 0 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 2:0.
30' 1 - 0 GOAL! Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) runs onto a pass from Anthony Gordon after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 1:0.
27' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
27' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
25' Total attempts – 4:4.
22' Tim Robinson interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd).
21' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.

17' Martin Dubravka doesn't have to worry about this one. James Maddison plays a pass into the feet of Timo Werner (Tottenham), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the right post.
17' A pass lands at the feet of Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.

16' Timo Werner (Tottenham) receives a precise pass inside the box and fires the ball goalwards. His attempt is blocked by one of his teammates, though, and ricochets away off him. Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
14' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) swings in a cross from the corner, but Guglielmo Vicario reads it well and gathers the ball.

14' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick.
13' A spell of possession for Tottenham in an attempt to control the game.
10' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) does well to meet the corner from Anthony Gordon, but his close-range header is soft and goes miles wide of the right post.
10' The referee awards a corner and Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) goes over to take it.
10' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

9' A cross is whipped into the box by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) and Harvey Barnes controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Newcastle.
7' Timo Werner (Tottenham) cushions the ball on his chest then hits a first-time volley high over the bar from inside the box.
7' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) works the corner short.

6' A lofted cross from Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out of play. Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
3' The resulting corner from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is cleared by the defence.
3' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
3' Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Good work from Newcastle as they win a corner.

2' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Tim Robinson blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
1' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Tottenham will have the kick-off.
Tim Robinson will officiate today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
